integrity: The compressed update and algebraic sharpness are established analytically; finite standalone numerical checks are supplementary. Independent priority and correctness audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact real symmetric positive-definite 2 by 2 quadratic; first zero-feedback top-one step; ideal largest continuously Armijo-admissible full-gradient step; no stochastic, multi-step, finite-grid, or convergence conclusion.
title: The sharp conditioning frontier for Armijo-before-top-one gradient compression
